question.question:
A firm must retire exactly 290 carbon credits against this year's target. A credit is eligible for retirement only if its vintage year is 2020 or later. The firm already holds 60 credits, all of vintage 2024. If the held credits are eligible, they are applied to the target first and any held credits beyond the target become surplus; if ineligible, none are applied and all 60 are sold at the legacy price of 4.5 USD per credit. Any remaining shortfall is covered by buying eligible credits only in whole bundles of 100 credits at 9.25 USD per credit, using the fewest bundles that cover the shortfall. All surplus credits (bundle excess plus any excess eligible held credits) are resold at 10 percent below the purchase price. Compute the net cash outlay in USD as purchase cost minus all resale and legacy proceeds.

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 2 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd` with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Held credits counted toward the target after the vintage eligibility test.
Fewest whole bundles needed to cover the remaining shortfall.
Total surplus credits resold, from bundle excess and excess eligible holdings.
